- YuNet-MIT.txt applies to models/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx only. The StreamSnip multi-frame detection, candidate selection, confidence logic, and framing workflow are project code.
- JetBrains-Mono-OFL.txt applies to the bundled JetBrains Mono font.
- Taste-Skill-MIT.txt applies to the selected motion and moment runtime files under docs/assets/motion/ and docs/assets/moments/. It does not apply to StreamSnip AI's product UI or application code. The same notice is also installed beside the font in the desktop application assets.
